en:
That day, we were supposed to
sail the sea of stars in peace,
without incident... or so it
should have been.
...Captain! Please wake up,\nCaptain!

Are you surprised by this
sight? While you were napping
at your seat, the scenery
inside the ship suddenly
changed!
No, it's not just the scenery.\nIt's... our clothes, too.

Good grief, everyone's in
swimwear! Everything,
everything, everything has
turned into swimwear!
Edge, you pervert! Don't get\nexcited at a time like this!

Getting excited over this? You
boys are so cute. Personally, I
don't think this is much
different from my usual attire.

Setting the look aside, why are
we like this...? Did the walls get
repainted and our clothes
changed in an instant...?

Of course not. Both this
scenery and our outfits are the
result of advanced spatial
projection.

You can't see the walls or our
clothes... but you can touch
them, right? It's like a
hologram... no, more like a
Battle Simulator.

Oh, you're right. I can touch my
original clothes... and my hand
passes right through Myuria's
waist cloth... it's just an illusion.

My, Captain, surely you can
understand spatial projection
without touching it? Stop
fidgeting. ...You too, Edge.
Hmph!
I wasn't "fidgeting," that's a\nfalse accusation! Right,\nCaptain?

A false accusation? Do you
prefer wet swimsuits? I didn't
realize preferences were so
subdivided on Earth...!
Tsk, no, that's not it...! At this\nrate, my reputation is just\ngoing to keep getting worse!

If this is a spatial projection, I
think the cause is an anomaly
in the Battle Simulator. Let's
hurry and go check on it.
Ow! I bumped into something!
Edge! I can't see, but that's\nprobably a wall. The door is\nthis way...!

Ow, ow, ow... My eyes are
spinning. It's dangerous if I
don't feel my way around. Let's
see, this is...
E-Edge! That's my...!
Whoa, sorry Clair! But it\ndefinitely didn't feel like skin,\nso that's a safe touch...!
No way! You pervert, Edge!

I-It's true, in this situation... If
we don't hurry, Edge's
reputation will only continue to
deteriorate...

It seems the hallways and all
the other rooms have turned
into beaches. The area of
effect must be quite extensive.
Yes... and it looks like everyone\nis enjoying this situation more\nthan I expected.
Yay! It's been so long since I've\nseen the ocean! This feels so\ngood!
I wonder if there are any beach\nstalls! You know, the ones with\nyakisoba and parfaits!
Miki, Millie! We don't even know\nwhat's going on, so this is no\ntime to be frolicking!

For someone saying that, you
look like you're having fun
chasing them, Rena. Miki and
the others are all having a
blast, too.

How can everyone be so
excited about these
embarrassing outfits? Is this
normal for everyone!?

...They're truly enjoying
themselves. It's a wonderful
smile. I'm relieved it's not born
of sadness or suffering.

Even so, the imagery is
incredibly precise. Projecting
this across the entire ship
requires a highly advanced
simulation. Only one thing can
do this...

It's gotta be the Battle
Simulator, the one with the
largest-scale simulation
functions on the ship.
Still, the projection range is\nreckless. Something must be\nhappening. ...Let's hurry!
The room containing that\nsimulator should be around this\narea. Let's see, the door is...
Eh? The door opened from the\nother side...?

Oh? I thought it was noisy
outside, but it's just the
Captain and the others. You're
here already!

Now, now, no need for thanks.
If it surprised you and brought
you joy, then all my hard work
modifying it was worth it!
Does that mean... Verda is the\none who created this\nsituation!?
Indeed! I just tinkered with the\nBattle Simulator a little bit\nand...

...No, I shouldn't show off. With
Coro's help, I worked hard to
project the beach across the
entire ship!
My... I am surprised. But, how\nshould I put this... While your\nhard work is impressive...
Ugh... That's...

Huh? Everyone's reaction is
different than I expected... I
thought they'd be overjoyed by
the open sea!

Ha! Worried I broke the Battle
Simulator? Don't be! Its
functions haven't diminished at
all!
Here, go ahead and try it! I can\nstill spawn enemies just fine!

I see, so the Battle Simulator's
functions haven't changed.
You've just added the ability to
project beaches and outfits
across the entire fleet.

I don't know the technical
details, but Verda's technical
skills are truly amazing. I'm
impressed...

But doing this all of a sudden
without even consulting us...
This is more than just a prank,
Verda.
...Umu, judging by everyone's\nreaction, it seems I may have\nmiscalculated...?
The truth is...
Were you trying to recreate\nlast year's ocean?
Was it to help everyone relieve\nstress?
Was it for tropical banana\ncultivation?!

As expected of the Captain,
you saw right through me. Tika
was muttering, "Last year's
ocean was so much fun"...

I couldn't play along back then
because of other business, so I
got a bit too excited thinking,
"This summer, for sure!"...

Well, things have been heavy
lately. I thought seeing the vast
blue sea would be a good
change of pace for everyone.

Tika was telling everyone about
last year's ocean, so the little
ones were saying they wanted
to go to the beach, too.

That's right. We'll cultivate
tropical bananas―delicious to
eat and great souvenirs―to
make them the centerpiece of
our interstellar trade...
...As if! How much do I even\nlove bananas?! Well, I do love\nthem, but still!
...In any case, I should have\nconsulted with you, Captain. My\napologies.
I'd stop this immediately, but\nonly Coro knows the code to\ncancel all ship-wide projections.

After finishing the simulator
modifications, that fellow went
off somewhere looking quite
pleased with himself.

Is that so...? Hmm, we could
probably force the simulator to
stop, but we might end up
breaking it.

Oh, then there's no need to
stop it. This situation is quite
nice; I'd like to take my time
and enjoy it.

I'm sure Coro-kun will be back
before long, so it's fine to leave
it like this for a while. Since we
have the chance, why don't you
take a little break too,
Captain?
Alright! Here comes the serve,\nbig sisters! Hyaa!
Okay! Receive! Sophia, I'm\ncounting on you!
All right! Secret Technique!\nLightning Spike!
Waaaaah!? I-I can't catch it!
Don't worry, leave it to me!\nSpin Receive!

Clair negotiated with the
Captain to keep this beach,
didn't she? It was a good call.
Everyone seems to be having a
wonderful time.

With all the people and paths
changing... it feels like it's been
a long time since I've seen
such bright, cheerful smiles.

The Captain has been working
hard, and I just wanted those
in leadership positions to have
a chance to rest as well.
Why don't you relax in a beach\nchair, Maria, until Coro shows\nup?

You're right... though you seem
to have settled in quite well
yourself. You look very
relaxed...

Phew! That was a great swim!
The ocean really is something
else. They call it an illusion, but
I can't tell it apart from the
real thing.

I feel refreshed after catching
some waves. Being with Lati
helps me stay disciplined with
my training, so it's a huge help.

Ah... Edge, you do tend to get
caught up in strange
accidents. Especially when
you're wearing so little clothing.
Yeah, exactly... it happened\nagain this time... No, well, never\nmind.
Since we're here, I want to\nmove around a bit more. What\nshould I do...?

Hey, Edge! If so, how about
combat training under this vast
sea and sky? The sense of
freedom is on a whole different
level!
Heh, that sounds great! I'll take\nyou up on that.

All right, then I'll gather some
enemies that look like they
belong by the water! Come on
out!

Haha, it feels strange having
combat training here on the
beach with everyone, but it's
fun!

It's so wide and open, it's on a
whole different level. The sea
breeze feels great against my
sweaty skin!

Clair! I tried it out, and it's
really good. It looks like there
are new weapons too, so why
don't you join us?

Thanks, Nel. I appreciate the
invite, but... I want to forget
about fighting today, so I'll
pass.

It feels weird having special
moves flying around right next
to people playing beach ball...
Though it is refreshing to
watch.

Hey, Verda. Are those enemies
and skills all just illusions from
the simulator? Can you make
other illusions too?

Hmm, I've only prepared this
sea, but I can manifest people
or enemies along with all their
skills...

Just like your swimsuits, I can
use people or enemies as a
screen to project different
clothes or forms... in other
words, overlay them.

I have data on your swimsuits
from Coro. For instance, I could
project Rena's detailed
swimsuit appearance onto an
enemy.

Huh, so the enemies would all
become Rena? I'd like to see
that. Would their skills become
Rena's too?

They would. After all, this is
ultimately the Battle Simulator.
Now then, let me show you a
demonstration.
Ah, wait, hold on...!
W-wah!? There's another me...!?
Whoa, that's amazing. You can't\ntell the difference from the\nreal thing just by looking.

W-wah, am I really wearing
something that bold!? Seeing it
head-on like this is so
embarrassing...
Oh, it's fine. It's white and\nsimple, so it looks healthy and\nsuitable for training.

You're right, I think it's perfect
for training. Since we're at it, I
might want to try sparring with
this Rena-chan.
R-really...? Well, if you say so, I\nguess that's good...

Ugh, it's hard to fight an
enemy with my own face... But
maybe sparring is meaningful
to learn my own weaknesses...
Fake Rena: ...Hehe.
Fake Rena: Hey, you, Captain!\nWhy don't you come have some\nfun with me?
W-what was that?! I would\nnever say something like that!
Oh? That's strange.

It merely wears Rena's
appearance, so her thoughts
and actions shouldn't change...
In fact, it shouldn't even be
able to speak.
Fake Rena: Captain... I\nloooooove you...!
Whoa, it's attacking! Everyone,\nintercept! ...Though, I might be\na little jealous of the Captain.
What are you thinking, Edge?!
Fake Rena: Don't get in my\nwaaaaay! Splayed Shaver!
Whoa! This thing is strong!
I have to protect the Captain's\ndignity and my own! Everyone,\nlend me your strength!
Fake Rena: Aaan, that's so\nmean... I just wanted to give\nthe Captain a big, tight hug...
Don't do things like that using\nmy appearance! What if people\nmisunderstand!

Wh-what is this? Has the
enemy AI malfunctioned? I
don't recall tampering with it
that much...
I've been watching, but Fake\nRena's behavior... doesn't it\nsomehow remind you of Coro?

Ha...! Now that you mention it! I
think Coro was messing with
the enemy AI so "the Captain
could have more fun"!

...I see. You programmed the AI
to initiate skinship with the
Captain if it was generated in a
swimsuit.
That kind of programming is a\nproblem
That's our Coro, he knows\nwhat's up!
Clair, you were just watching,\nright?

Ho ho, as expected of our
Captain. Such a gentlemanly
remark. You know, you could
try being a bit more honest,
like Edge.

That's a false accusation,
Verda! I wouldn't want an AI
like that either! If Reimi saw me
being hugged by Rena...
Hmm...?
You like that kind of thing,\nCaptain!? I can't believe you!
I can see why Rena-chan is so\nupset. I wonder if all men are\nlike this...
Ugh, thank you for\nunderstanding. It must be hard\nfor you too, Reimi-san...

Yes, I had decided to just relax
and enjoy my vacation today...
so I was simply watching the
entertainment.
So that's what happens when a\nserious professional tries to\ntruly take a break...

Yes, the power gap wasn't
enough to lose... Ah, I shouldn't
slip into analysis mode like
that. Hehe.
Ugh... I know Coro-kun was just\ntrying to entertain the Captain,\nbut this is going too far!

I enjoyed this vacation too...
but Coro-kun's antics definitely
require some punishment.
Hehe.

...Clair-san, hasn't her vibe been
a little different for a while
now? Is she sleepwalking or
something...?
Ahh, not here! Everyone, watch\nout! That Clair isn't the usual\nClair!
Wh-what, could it be...! Is she\nanother one of Coro's AI\ncreations!?

No, that's not it! I let her try a
"whip" added to the simulator,
and she seems to have taken a
strange liking to it...

Hehe... A rare vacation, a
precious break from the
everyday. Don't you want to...
give out plenty of
punishments?

...Perhaps it's the vacation's
freedom, but something that
should never be unleashed has
been unleashed.

Or maybe she's awakened
something that was never
meant to wake up... She might
actually get along with Coro.
I'm sorry, I'm so sorry. The\nusual Clair isn't like this at all...
Hehe... Coro gets a punishment\ntoo, but Verda, you're quite the\naccomplice, aren't you?

I'm going to punish you, so
come here, okay? And those
who get in my way get
punished too!
A-Awaaa! Everyone, run for it!

This story has ended. We plan
to release various other stories
in the future. Please look
forward to them.
...Ah. What on earth was I\ndoing?

Phew... Once I deactivated the
whip projection, you seemed to
come to your senses. That was
a close one.

To think a mere whip could
cause such a transformation.
Have you been under a great
deal of stress lately?

It seems I've shown you
something embarrassing... I
don't have much stress.
Without war, I've been quite at
ease.

If anything, life on this ship is
so much fun and the ocean is
so vast... I may have simply let
myself go a bit too far.

I see, then that's a relief. It
makes all the hard work Coro
and I put into the modifications
worthwhile.
Well then, perhaps I shall enjoy\nthe sea a little myself. Will you\njoin me, Clair?
Ah, Big Sister Verda~! This\nocean is so much fun! Thank\nyou!
Oh, Tika! I'm glad to see you're\nhaving such a good time!
Hello, Clair! Since we're all here,\nwhy don't you come swimming\nwith us?
Thank you for the invitation,\nTika. I'd love to. What about\nyou, Verda?
Oh, swimming... is it? It's a kind\noffer, but I'm, well...

Wait, Verda, is that floatie... did
you make it yourself? It's so
huge, you're not actually...
unable to swim, are you?

Daaaaah! I can't help it! I grew
up in a laboratory in a snowy
country! I've only ever seen the
ocean in books!

Well, that's that. I plan to just
float around on my ring, so you
two go ahead and enjoy your
swimming.
...Tika. I don't know Verda very\nwell, so I must ask...
...She isn't just holding back\nher desire to play with us out\nof politeness, is she?

No, she's fine. If she really
wanted to play... or rather,
swim with us, she'd just whip
something up and join in.

That's true. My goodness...
Verda is much smarter than
she looks, and quite
considerate as well.

I wonder if I was that
thoughtful at her age. I only
remember being excited and
riding on my father's shoulders
when we went to the sea.
Tika, you... you haven't really\nhad a chance to have a proper\nchildhood, have you?
Hmm, now that you mention it,\nmaybe not. Does that bother\nyou?

An infinite sea of stars, the
eternal flow of time... Drifting
within them, one can only feel
bewildered by the differences
in each person's
circumstances.
Elicoor was a land of war, yet I\nspent my girlhood as a blessed\nchild in a wealthy household...

I feel a sense of guilt, or
rather, a feeling that my
sensibilities might be out of
sync with everyone else's...

Your father, Adray, was a
major figure in the nation.
Being part of the ruling class
for generations must have
brought its own burdens.
But, Clair. You don't need to\nmake that face while you're on\nthis ship.

From me to Big Sister Verda,
everyone on this crew has a
past. We're all "family" who
understand each other.

...Tika. You might be right.
Regardless of my feelings, I
should focus on living in the
moment with everyone...

Yes! Don't look so troubled in
such a vast ocean! Come on,
let's swim! You're a good
swimmer, aren't you?

Hehe... Thank you. You're right,
my father trained me quite
extensively, so I won't lose to
most people.
Ho ho! Friendship is a beautiful\nthing. And you two are both\nswimming quite well!

Even with these fancy floaties,
I can't keep up. After all, this is
my very first time even
stepping into the sea!

Listening to everyone's joyful
voices while letting this floatie
carry me along... just relaxing
like this... this is pure
paradise...
...Hm? What's going on? This\nfloatie is suddenly shaking...
...Nuoohhh!? D-Don't move on\nyour own! Where are you taking\nme~?!

...Oh? Verda is certainly
energetic. It looks like her
swimming improved all of a
sudden...

N-No, that's not it! The floatie
is running wild! W-We have to
catch her! It'll be bad if she
gets carried out to sea!

Ah, I know that feeling! It'll be
fine. Once, while riding my
father as he swam, he carried
me all the way to the
neighboring continent...

Th-That is clearly outside the
realm of normal experience!
Anyway, let's go after her
together!

Phew... I never thought I'd be
betrayed by my own floatie. I
wish the rebellion of creations
would stay strictly within the
realm of fiction.
That was a close one, Verda\nKleiman. I lent a hand with the\nrescue as well.
Ugh... My apologies. Thank you\nfor your trouble, Mastima.

Are you enjoying the sea? I'm
not one to talk, but you
shouldn't spend all your time
cooped up in your lab.
Lab? What are you talking\nabout?

Well, haven't you been
completely stuck on your
research into Summoning Crest
Arts lately?

Was I? Regardless, I have no
time to be preoccupied with
such things right now. The
most important thing is―yes!
Owner Mastima: Managing the\nbeach shack "<font color=yellow>Ocean House Hot\n& Cool</font>"!
Wha―What in the world?! Since\nwhen was a video of the shop\nbeing projected?!

Eat up for piping hot Spicule!
We've got blazing <font color=yellow>Hot Yakisoba</font>
and a new God-tier addition
this year!

Jewel-like fruits crafted by a
master patissier. Let this
year's <font color=yellow>Eleven-Berry Parfait</font>
captivate you with its new
brilliance!

Owner Mastima: Top that
parfait with the finest
direct-from-the-source vanilla
ice cream... Now, lose yourself
in this trinity of tasty melodies!!

I-I don't know! The simulator
never made a shop like this.
And what's wrong with you all?!
Your characters have
completely changed!!

Ha... Are they all strange AI like
Rena? Maybe the simulator is
being pushed too hard and is
starting to bug out...

Hey, what's the deal? You
won't eat our food? Customers
are acting pretty cold this
year.

We're pouring all our skill into
this seasonal feast, yet you're
just a girl who doesn't
understand the value of things.

Owner Mastima: No... perhaps
the spiciness of the Hot
Yakisoba is simply too much
for a young child.

Owner Mastima: Why not pile
cream and vanilla ice cream
onto the yakisoba like a
mountain... yes, like a
mountain?
Wait, wait! It's one thing for\nthings to bug out, but don't go\nbugging out the sense of taste!
Y-Yes. If we did that, wouldn't\nit be like buying a one-way\nticket to hell?

Owner Mastima: But, I want to
know what that would taste
like... I want to try it freely...
without being disturbed.

Well said! That infinite
Academic Thirst... you really
are the owner of the rival shop
that used to give us so much
trouble!

True, you won't know the taste
unless you try! Alright, if I pour
this parfait over it, it'll cover
everything! Here goes, boom!

Gwaaaaah! Stop that heresy!
How dare you treat the works
of art I've created so
carelessly...!

Owner Mastima: Oh, a
magnificent creation with ice
cream, cream, and berries!
Now, time for a taste test!

Owner Mastima: Th-this is...!
Even in my 3.7 billion years,
I've never tasted anything like
this! Something... something is
awakening!
Owner Mastima: It's... it's\ndelicious~~!
Owner Mastima: Oooooooooh~!
Good heavens, has that intense\nflavor actually drawn out his\ntrue power?!

He's spitting plasma from his
mouth! At this rate, not just
the beach shack, but the whole
damn beach is gonna be gone!
...A-ahhh! Mastima, don't look\nthis way! Someone, help meeee!
...U-um? Am I alive? If I recall, I\nwas blown away by Mastima...?
No, could it be... was I just\nnapping? ...Was that just a\ndream...?
That was a close one, Verda\nKleiman. You were tossing and\nturning quite violently.
N-no, Mastima?! How long have\nyou been standing there...?!\nDon't tell me that dream was...

N-no. I shall refrain from
pursuing it. One must not let
dreams or virtual realities
become reality.

Everyone who ordered water
guns for playing in the water~!
They're finished, so I've come
to deliver them~!

Heave-ho, heave-ho. Phew, this
is a huge amount. Is this
actually real and not just a
product of a simulation?
Heh heh heh! That just shows\nhow popular my skills are!

Making them fun yet realistic,
even as water guns! Balancing
both is where my talent truly
shines!
Wow, they really are all so\nwell-made! As expected of\nWelch-oneesan!
Hmm, hmm. So this part goes\nlike this, and if I press here,\nwater comes out? Let's see...
W-Whoa!
Oops, sorry Welch! It went off\naccidentally.

Heh heh heh... I figured this
might happen, so Eu-bo and I
changed into real swimsuits, so
it's fine!
Whoa!
Welch, what on earth is that?!\nThat's not a water gun\nanymore, it's a water cannon!!
Heh. It's what you call a victory\nfor technological prowess.

Welch!! When did you build a
weapon like that?! If you use
that, everyone's going to get
hurt!

You're exaggerating. I made
sure the output can be
adjusted. Look, if I set this
button to "Low"...
Kyaaaaaah!? I-I'm being swept\naway!

Are you okay, Tika?! Welch, is
that weapon even safe?! The
output clearly increased from
before!

W-well, this should be fine,
right? Everyone is training,
anyway! If they join the water
fight with this, it'll be good
training for them too!
Even if they're training, that\nwater pressure will hurt! You\nshouldn't use it for play.

B-but, I'm telling you, I made
this entire thing by myself from
the blueprints, so I really want
to use it.
Just once! Just once, as a test\nrun, I want to play with Eu and\nthe others...
Hmm...

Welch. It'll be too late once
someone gets injured. Let's
use these mass-produced
water guns today instead.
Fine.
I can't believe Welch-oneesama\ngave in that easily...\nEuwin-oniichan, you're amazing.

Well, we've known each other
for years. I'm just relieved we
didn't have any victims of
Welch's weaponry today.
If Welch built it from scratch, it\nmight go haywire and explode,\ntaking Welch herself with it...!
Hmm... It's certainly not an\nimpossible scenario... But Welch\nis probably...
...Eu-bo. Are you trying to say\nthat every machine I make is a\ndefective piece of junk!?

N-no, that's not it!! But those
machines were dangerous,
right? Like when I was your
test subject, you were always
failing...

It's not always!! It's just that,
once in a while, things go a tiny
bit haywire and end up being
completely destroyed!
Being completely destroyed is\na problem...

...Guh... Just what do you think
I'm doing, going through all this
trial and error with these
weapons for...?
For what...? Because tinkering\nwith machines is your hobby,\nright?

That's it, this is a duel, Eu-bo!
I'm going to beat you senseless
with Welch-chan's Lethal
Weapon!
Hey, I told you you weren't\ngoing to use that weapon\nearlier!
Don't worry, this time I'm only\naiming for you, Eu-bo! I won't\nlet anyone else get hurt!
Now, hurry up and grab that\nwater gun, Eu-bo!
...I don't think this is going to\nsettle down anytime soon.

Oh no, even Big Brother Euwin
couldn't stop her... Hey, Big
Sister Verda, is it okay to just
leave them alone!?
Hmm? Well, once things get to\nthat point, it's bad manners for\nan outsider to interfere.

Besides, Welch must have a
dream she refuses to back
down from. Though, she is far
too clumsy about it.
Eh? A dream...?
Oh, what is it, Rena? When did\nyou get there...?
Fake Rena: ...Wet swimsuit.\nNice.

What in the world! Has that
malfunctioning AI we
suppressed reappeared!? No...
this is...
Fake Rena: Wet swimwear,\ngood! I will take it home and\npresent it to the Captain!
Hyahhh! Hey, what are you\ntouching...! Awaaaaah!
Ahh, Welch is being abducted!?
This is bad! The simulator is\nrunning wild!
Fake Rena: Wet swimwear! I'm\ntaking it all home!
Welch, I'll push the enemies\nback from here, so use that\nopening to escape!
Thank you! Here I go, hyahhh!\nHydraulic Blaster!
Fake Rena: Gyaaa!
Phew... Thanks, Eu! You saved\nme!
Big sister Welch and the others\nare so perfectly in sync! You're\nso cool!

You two truly have impressive
coordination. Being creators,
you even handle those water
guns with skill!
Fake Rena: My swimsuit... my\nsoaked swimsuit...
But this is never going to end!\nWhat are we supposed to do?!

The modifications might have
put too much strain on the
Battle Simulator, causing a
thermal runaway.

You're the only ones who can
break through to the simulator
room in this state! Sorry, but
could you go?
Got it! Let's go, Welch!
You bet! Don't fall behind, Eu!

The spatial projection is cut
off just here!? And it's
incredibly hot! I feel like I'm
going to get burned...!
Any machine would malfunction\nin this heat. Just what\nhappened...?!
